title: Large Hadron Collider Ka Sabse Bada Sach! 🔬 #shorts
idea: Mind-blowing facts about the Large Hadron Collider's extreme underground depth, freezing temperature, and near-light-speed particle collisions.

lines.text: Kya aap jaante ho duniya ki sabse badi machine zameen ke neeche chupi hai?
Ye 27 kilometer lambi tunnel zameen se 175 metre neeche bani hai.
Is machine ke magnets ko minus 271 degree Celsius par thanda rakha jaata hai.
Yahan protons har ek second mein 11,245 chakkar poore karte hain!
Inki speed light ki speed se sirf 11 km/h kam hoti hai!
Kya insaan kabhi light ki exact speed ko match kar paayega?

Duniya ki sabse badi machine Large Hadron Collider ki speed aur temperature sunkar aap dang reh jaoge! Jaaniye iska sabse anokha sach.

#largehadroncollider #sciencefacts #physics #mindblowingfacts #shorts

facts.claim: The tunnel is 27 km in circumference and 175 m deep underground.
Magnets operate at minus 271.25 degrees Celsius.
Protons move only 11 km/h slower than the speed of light.
